		REIMB_AMOUNT as integer,
		RESPONSE_BATCH_ID as string,
		STATUS as string,
		ACCOUNT_NUM as string,
		REIMB_CODE as string,
		CONF_NUMBER as string,
		DIVISION_CODE as string,
		ERROR_CODE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		REIMB_AMOUNT,
		RESPONSE_BATCH_ID,
		STATUS,
		ACCOUNT_NUM,
		REIMB_CODE,
		CONF_NUMBER,
		DIVISION_CODE,
